# Instr

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Strings](Language-Features-Strings)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Instr:Int32 string:String, find:String, from:Int32=1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text to search in. |
| `find` | In | String | required | The text to look for. |
| `from` | In | Int32 | `1` | Position to start searching at. Defaults to 1. |

**Returns:** The position of the first match, or 0.

## Description

Finds the first position of a piece of text inside another string. Positions start at 1, and 0 means it was not found. The search tells upper and lower case apart.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Instr("hello world", "o")
Print Instr("hello world", "o", 6)
Print Instr("hello", "z")
```

```text
5
8
0
```
